name: Securities Conversion
definition: Conversion exchange of securities, generally convertible bonds or preferred equities, into another form of securities, usually common equities.

ConversionDate.name: Conversion Date
ConversionDate.definition: Deadline by which a convertible security must be converted according to the terms of the issue.

ConversionType.name: Conversion Type
ConversionType.definition: Specifies the conversion type of an instrument.

BusinessDayConvention.name: Business Day Convention
BusinessDayConvention.definition: Convention used for adjusting a date when it is not a business day.

ConversionChoice.name: Conversion Choice
ConversionChoice.definition: Specifies whether the conversion is mandatory or optional.

ConversionFixedExchangeRate.name: Conversion Fixed Exchange Rate
ConversionFixedExchangeRate.definition: Currency exchange rate between the bond currency and the underlying equity currency used to calculate the convertion ratio.

ConversionMarginAmount.name: Conversion Margin Amount
ConversionMarginAmount.definition: Amount of cash needed for the conversion.

ConversionOption.name: Conversion Option
ConversionOption.definition: Specifies information about the choices offered to the holder of a conversion.

ConversionQuotedCurrency.name: Conversion Quoted Currency
ConversionQuotedCurrency.definition: Currency into which the base currency is converted, in a currency exchange.

FinancialCenter.name: Financial Center
FinancialCenter.definition: Financial place  taken into account to adjust the date and time, as defined within the business day convention.

MinimumNoticeDays.name: Minimum Notice Days
MinimumNoticeDays.definition: Minimum number of days that must be given by either the issuer or the holder before conversion can take place.

NoticePeriodType.name: Notice Period Type
NoticePeriodType.definition: Specifies the type of notice period.

ProtectionAgainstDilutionIndicator.name: Protection Against Dilution Indicator
ProtectionAgainstDilutionIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the security is protected against dilution with regards to capital events.

ReverseConversionIndicator.name: Reverse Conversion Indicator
ReverseConversionIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the bond is convertible into an equity and back to the bond.

PartyType.name: Party Type
PartyType.definition: Specifies if the issuer or the holder are allowed to convert the security into another one.

ContractSize.name: Contract Size
ContractSize.definition: Ratio or multiplying factor used to convert one contract into a quantity.

ConversionPrice.name: Conversion Price
ConversionPrice.definition: Price of one target security in the conversion.

MinimumExercisableQuantity.name: Minimum Exercisable Quantity
MinimumExercisableQuantity.definition: Minimum quantity of financial instrument or lot of rights/warrants that must be exercised.

MinimumExercisableMultipleQuantity.name: Minimum Exercisable Multiple Quantity
MinimumExercisableMultipleQuantity.definition: Minimum multiple quantity of financial instrument or lot of rights/warrants that must be exercised.

MaximumExercisableQuantity.name: Maximum Exercisable Quantity
MaximumExercisableQuantity.definition: Indicates the maximum quantity of financial instrument that may be exercised in the event.

ConversionPeriod.name: Conversion Period
ConversionPeriod.definition: Period during which a convertible security may be converted according to the terms of the issue.

ConversionRatioDenominator.name: Conversion Ratio Denominator
ConversionRatioDenominator.definition: Number of held securities for the conversion.

ConversionRatioNumerator.name: Conversion Ratio Numerator
ConversionRatioNumerator.definition: Number of target securities for the conversion.

Ratio.name: Ratio
Ratio.definition: Ratio applied to convert the related security.

ConversionUnitCurrency.name: Conversion Unit Currency
ConversionUnitCurrency.definition: Currency in which the rate of exchange is expressed in a currency exchange. In the example 1GBP = xxxCUR, the unit currency is GBP.

RelatedOption.name: Related Option
RelatedOption.definition: Option for which securities conversion information is provided.

SecurityIdentification.name: Security Identification
SecurityIdentification.definition: ISIN identification of the related financial instrument into which this security can be converted.
